title: Your Bank is Coming to Your Doorstep: Understanding the Nationwide Financial Inclusion Camps
description: The government has launched a nationwide campaign to bring essential banking services closer to you. From October 21 to December 31, 2026, special camps are b.

faq.q: What if I already have a bank account and insurance?
faq.a: Even if you have these, you can still visit the camps to update your KYC, add or change nominations, or learn about digital fraud prevention.

faq.q: How can I find out where and when a camp is happening near me?
faq.a: You should look for official announcements from your local bank branches, Gram Panchayat office, or Urban Local Body office. Government websites and local news channels may also provide schedules.

faq.q: Are these services available only during the campaign period?
faq.a: While many services are always available at bank branches, these special camps are a concentrated effort to reach a wider audience and provide focused assistance during the October 21 - December 31, 2026 period.

faq.q: What documents should I carry to the camp?
faq.a: It's advisable to carry your Aadhaar card, PAN card, bank passbook, and any existing insurance policy documents or pension scheme details you have. For KYC updates, proof of address might also be needed.
